description: Committee recommends relocating 1.4 acres of municipal reserve.
New reserve land in City Centre, College Corridor areas.
Replaces reserve removed from 1635 McKercher Drive.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Councillor Kelleher supported Option 2C for adding park space downtown to attract residents.
Residents of City Centre and College Corridor will gain new park space.
Administration stated Option 1 satisfies the act but not Council's intent.
Mayor Block expressed confusion about the difference between parks and municipal reserve.
Administration promised conceptual renderings for the College Corridor park space.

description: Saskatoon would establish a new downtown revitalization reserve.
It would fund planning and preparing key projects.
Council would approve a prioritized downtown project list.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
5 for, 1 against
Chair noted upcoming budget challenges will require clear justification for new FTEs.
Downtown Saskatoon businesses and 18,000 employees are affected.
Question about planning for a downtown school for future families remains unanswered.
Downtown YXE supports the recommended options, but urges more ambitious long-term investment.
Councillor Parker opposed, citing the strategy's lack of ambition and reliance on external funding.
Downtown's 1,500 unhoused individuals need essential services and safety responses.
Administration committed to annually reviewing and updating the prioritized project list.
